answer: Admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch opens 100 slots: applicants bid, the top 100 win and lock 50 tokens in a vault for 20 epochs. Even at the nadir of demand, a slot costs its deposit, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 tokens locked 20 epochs, far above one epoch's reward. A shared nebula of funding links identities paid together as one cluster, and they are rejected. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
